crons._comment: Daily at 04:00 UTC — generate upcoming mission occurrences. tickRecurrences caps at 8 occurrences per recurrence per run with a 28-day horizon (src/app/actions/recurrences.ts:296).

Daily at 06:00 UTC — sends next-day mission reminders to assigned agents. Mode defaults to 'both' (reminders + late alerts in one tick). Late alerts have limited utility on a daily cadence; upgrade to Vercel Pro for sub-daily scheduling if real-time late alerts are needed.
